functions.name: VfxEval_FunctionTable
functions.note: 24-byte entries {name, argument count, flag, function}: SrgbGammaToLinear, TextureAverageColor, MatrixMultiply, MatrixColorCorrect2, MatrixColorTint2 and the rest

functions.name: VfxEval_MatrixMultiply
functions.note: two 4x4 off the stack, product through 180081100

functions.name: VfxEval_MatrixColorTint2
functions.note: (tint, amount) -> 1800818d0 (white equals ColorCorrect(1, 1, 1) word for word; coloured not ported)

functions.name: ColorMatrix_Correct
functions.note: ((((((D^-1 R^T) diag(sat, sat, 1)) R) D) diag(bright)) (T(a) diag(contrast)) T(-a)); R = 1800828c0(normalised (0.2125, 0.7154, 0.0721), z)

functions.name: Matrix4_Multiply
functions.note: row-major a x b, each element dpps: (a0 b0 + a1 b1) + (a2 b2 + a3 b3)

functions.name: Vector3_Normalize
functions.note: length sqrt((y y + z z) + x x); within 1e-17..1e17 times its reciprocal

functions.name: Matrix4_RotationBetween
functions.note: unit f to unit t: axis cross(f, t) over its length (the sine), cos = (fz tz + ty fy) + fx tx; identity when the cross is 0

functions.name: ColorMatrix_Tint
functions.note: D^-1 R^T (translate, diag(1 - s, 1 - s, 1 - pow(...) amount), translate back) R D; ported for white only

functions.name: VfxEval_TextureAverageColor
functions.note: the texture manager's average colour (vtable +0x2d8), w 1

functions.name: MatrixColorCorrect
functions.note: Haeberli-style: translate by -average, contrast, saturation about luminance (0.2125, 0.7154, 0.0721), brightness, back

functions.name: MatrixColorTint
functions.note: tint about luminance with a powf amount term
